samples.summary: Registry-derived font wait now gates the whole visual lane on KaTeX's locally-served @font-face families, which the refetch recovery and the operator diagnostic do not cover
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/index.css:4` does `@import "katex/dist/katex.min.css"`, and `packages/frontend/src/main.tsx:2` imports `index.css` for every route including `/harness/visual`. KaTeX registers ~16 families (`KaTeX_AMS`, `KaTeX_Math` — italic-only faces, `KaTeX_Script`, `KaTeX_Size1..4`, `KaTeX_Fraktur`, …) into `document.fonts`. The old wait enumerated 7 Google families, so those faces were irrelevant (the old catch-all only asserted no face was `status === "loading"`, which an `error`/`unloaded` KaTeX face satisfies). `registry()` (verify-visual-browser.mjs:385-396) now enumerates *every* registered family and `pending()` (415-439) demands per-family `status === "loaded"` plus a per-weight `fonts.check()` for each. So a KaTeX family that never reaches `loaded` — an italic-only family whose `check('400 12px "KaTeX_Math"')` does not resolve, or any woff2 the Vite dev server fails to serve out of node_modules — now fails every one of the 24 passes and hard-fails the run at line 754. Neither recovery nor diagnosis reaches it: `refetchPass` (463-473) only re-points `link.href.startsWith("https://fonts.googleapis.com/")`, and the failure message at line 636 tells the operator to "Check network access to fonts.googleapis.com", which misdiagnoses a local asset failure. Fix belongs on the new code: scope the awaited registry to the families the app actually fetches over the network (or exclude same-origin/non-Google faces), or at minimum make the report name the face's src origin.

samples.summary: Worst-case added wait on a webfont failure can push the verify-browser job past its 20-minute ceiling, losing the artifacts this change exists to preserve
samples.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:144 sets `timeout-minutes: 20` for `verify-browser`, sized at "~2.2x the worst observed" (max 9.3 min) per the comment at ci.yml:139-143. There are 4 profiles × 6 passes = 24 `waitForFontsReady` calls; on a font failure the first pass burns 3 × FONT_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS (10s) plus refetch networkidles and each remaining pass burns another 10s, adding ~4-5 minutes of pure waiting to an already-failing ~9 minute run. A GitHub job killed by `timeout-minutes` does not run the `if: failure()` upload step at ci.yml:175-183, so the very artifacts the new "record and keep capturing" design is meant to preserve would be lost in exactly the scenario it targets. Would need a measured failing-run duration to confirm.

verdict.reason: Every element of the claim checks out in the working tree. `packages/frontend/src/index.css:4` imports `katex/dist/katex.min.css`; `packages/frontend/src/main.tsx:2` loads that CSS for the entire SPA; and `packages/frontend/src/App.tsx:83` routes `/harness/visual` — the exact URL captured by `verify-visual-browser.mjs:14` — inside that app, so KaTeX's CSS-connected `@font-face` families are members of `document.fonts` on every capture pass. The new wait derives its target set from that registry with no origin or family filter: `registry()` (verify-visual-browser.mjs:385-396) collapses *all* registered faces to family->weights, `load()` (399-413) actively fetches each family/weight, and `pending()` (415-439) demands both a per-family `status === "loaded"` and a per-weight `document.fonts.check()`. That is strictly broader than the prior catch-all, which only rejected faces still `loading` (435-437) — an `error`/`unloaded` KaTeX face used to be benign and is now a hard failure. Recovery and diagnosis are Google-scoped and cannot reach these faces: `refetchPass` (463-473) only re-points `link[rel=stylesheet]` whose href starts with `https://fonts.googleapis.com/`, while KaTeX's rules arrive through Vite's injected style element, and the operator message at 634-637 says "Check network access to fonts.googleapis.com" for what would be a local `node_modules` asset failure, before `process.exit(1)` at 754-756 fails the run. No guard anywhere in the script scopes the awaited set (I read the file in full, 1-761). The one thing I could not verify is whether the KaTeX woff2 files actually resolve through the Vite dev server, since node_modules is not installed in this checkout; that affects only whether the failure fires, not the existence of the widened contract with an unreachable recovery path, so under the rubric the uncertainty keeps the finding. It is in-lane: a behaviour change whose out-of-diff consumer (the app's KaTeX stylesheet) was not considered.

finding.summary: VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES covers only 4 of the 8 `eager: true` families the app's own bootstrap link actually requests
finding.evidence: `ensureGoogleFontsLink()` builds its href from every `webFont && eager` catalog entry (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts:112-114). The generated source of truth lists EIGHT eager families: Noto Sans KR (font-catalog.data.ts:6), Noto Serif KR (:7), Nanum Gothic (:8), Nanum Myeongjo (:9), Gothic A1 (:13), Gowun Dodum (:14), Gowun Batang (:15), Roboto (:49). The diff's list names only four of them, so Nanum Myeongjo / Gothic A1 / Gowun Dodum / Gowun Batang remain in exactly the un-awaited state the PR is fixing for Inter. The eager set is machine-generated (packages/frontend/scripts/build-font-catalog.mjs:41 `const EAGER = new Set([...])`), so re-running the generator will silently widen it again with nothing updating the hardcoded script list. Fix belongs in verify-visual-browser.mjs:346 (or better, derive the list from FONT_CATALOG's eager entries).

verdict.reason: The premise does not hold in this repository: there is no hardcoded `VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES` (or any family/weight list) in the visual harness. A repo-wide grep finds the identifier only in the task doc's historical problem statement and in .agent-review artifacts, never in packages/. Instead, `waitForFontsReady` derives the awaited set from the live registry: `registry()` at packages/frontend/scripts/verify-visual-browser.mjs:385-396 iterates `for (const face of document.fonts)` collapsing every registered face to family -> declared weights (all endpoints of a variable range); `load()` at :399-413 loads every (family, weight); `pending()` at :415-439 requires at least one face per family to reach "loaded" plus a per-weight check(); and the poll at :451-456 re-reads the registry each tick, after a `networkidle` wait at :478. All eight eager families necessarily appear there, because `buildGoogleFontsHref()` (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts:111-115) emits one `family=` segment per `webFont && eager` entry into a single css2 stylesheet whose @font-face rules become registered faces. This is strictly broader than the finding's own suggested fix ("derive the list from FONT_CATALOG's eager entries"), since it also covers index.html families and lazily injected per-family links, and it is immune to the generator widening EAGER in build-font-catalog.mjs. The cited fix location, verify-visual-browser.mjs:346, is comment text, not a list definition.

finding.summary: New all-families × all-weights hard check demands weights index.html never requests; a miss turns a pixel diff into a 10s hard lane failure
finding.evidence: packages/frontend/index.html:12 requests `Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700` (no 400) and `JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500` (no 600/700), while the new gate (verify-visual-browser.mjs:384-393) requires `document.fonts.check()` to be true for every family at 400/500/600/700. It also assumes CSS weight-matching resolves the absent cuts to a loaded face; if that assumption is wrong for any family/weight pair (e.g. the variable-axis Fraunces registration), the waitForFunction throws and the whole visual lane hard-fails instead of producing a diff. The bootstrap URL is also duplicated in packages/documentation/.vitepress/config.ts:24, so a future narrowing of the weight list in either place is not reflected in the script.

verdict.reason: The finding describes code that is not in the tree. verify-visual-browser.mjs:385-396 derives the awaited set from document.fonts itself — per-face declared weights only — with no hard-coded family list and no 400/500/600/700 literal (grep finds none; VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES/FONT_WEIGHTS do not exist repo-wide), so the absent Fraunces-400 and JetBrains-Mono-600/700 cuts from index.html:12 are never demanded. There is also no page.waitForFunction gate: the poll is an in-page page.evaluate with its own deadline (376-379, 451-457, 479), and exhausting refetches records the pass and returns (488-494) so capturePass still takes every screenshot (533) — the run fails at the end with artifacts on disk, not by aborting mid-capture. The vacuous-check() concern is separately guarded by the per-family "at least one face loaded" assertion at 415-428, which runs before any check() at 430. The remaining duplicate bootstrap URL at packages/documentation/.vitepress/config.ts:24 is moot because the script mirrors no weight list.
